posts.text: Two numbers I'd like to see checked before I believe either side: the 50,000 at Arden's rally (organisers' figure, not a count) and the 200,000 jobs (what's the costing?). Ostrand's highway is real and I'll judge it by the traffic it carries. Same test for everyone.

Two stories today: VBC on the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV on the first debate and the costings questions both candidates faced. Before sharing, check the source and the numbers. Want to see the debate costings? Ask the moderators' fact sheet or the election commission's site. #VeloriaVotes
Watched the first debate. Ostrand on inflation, Arden on the 200k jobs number. Both got pressed on costings and neither answered cleanly. Still waiting for someone to show the math.

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on the Kessa highway while my diesel costs what it did. Nice road. Still paying more to drive to the market though. Arden at least said something about costs in the debate. Lets see if he means it.

Long shift, then I caught the debate on the break room TV. Arden talks about 200,000 jobs, but nobody asked where the money comes from until the moderators did. Still waiting on the staffing numbers for our ward too.

Saw the highway opening on VBC and the debate on Kito TV tonight. Roads are good, but my grocery prices are still bruising my wallet. Both of them need to show me the numbers. As my mother said: a promise is a loan.

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway = 'new era of prosperity' lmao. Arden promising 200k jobs with zero costings = also cringe. Two weeks left and I still don't know who to trust. Someone pls convince me

Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North. My cab will thank the president, the suspension definitely won't. Ostrand's debate answer on inflation was solid though, let's see what the costings say. #Veloria

Read the VeriCheck piece on Arden's plan. VAT doubling: FALSE. The 40% fuel number uses a peak month, so MISLEADING. The open question is the ~2% of GDP gap economists flagged. Ask both teams to close it.

Fuel up 40% is the number that matters to me. Ostrand's highway is nice but my diesel bill is what I feel every time I fill up. Arden at least named the cost problem in the debate. Show me the math on both and I'll decide. #VeloriaVotes
Unity Party says Arden's plan doubles the food VAT. Before anyone shares it: where's the actual plan text? A promise is a loan, and so is a claim. Show me the clause.

VBC's 'questions raised' clip on the Arden recording. Before anyone shares it: who authenticated it, and has the Civic Front's denial been checked? Show the chain of custody, not just the clip. Two weeks out, we need evidence, not vibes.

Day 3 and the WhatsApp 'leaked audio' is already flying around. Before forwarding anything: where's the file's origin, who verified it? VBC says 'questions raised', the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Wait for the actual check, not the forward button. #VeloriaVotes

Two things in my feed today. A 'leaked audio' forwarded 50 times with no source, and a VBC clip that the Civic Front says isn't genuine. Before anyone forwards either, ask where the original file came from and whether anyone has verified it. I'd rather wait for proof than spread something that might be fake. Still want the staffing numbers too. #VeloriaVotes

Two things today: a 'leaked' audio forwarded 50 times in WhatsApp, and VBC saying 'questions raised' over a recording. Nobody has verified either. Before I forward anything about Arden's commission talk, I want the source, the full clip, and what the Civic Front says it's proven not genuine. A rumour travels fast. Truth needs to be checked. #VeloriaVotes

VBC drops a 'questions raised' clip about a recording of Arden and calls it news. Where's the authentication? Who provided it, when was it made? Until someone shows the metadata, I'm treating this like the 40% fuel stat: cherry-picked and missing context. Ask the source, not the vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Watched the VBC clip on the Arden recording. A clip played in full still tells me nothing about where it came from. Who recorded it, when, and has anyone checked the file metadata? Until the Civic Front's denial is tested against something, I'm holding judgement. Same test as always: show me the source.

VBC is running a clip 'questioning' a recording of Arden. The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before sharing anything: who verified the audio, and is there an independent forensic check or an original file? Show the source, not just the clip. #VeloriaVotes

Three things on the 'leaked audio' today: it's been forwarded everywhere with no source, the Civic Front says it's a fake, and VBC only said 'questions raised' and played the whole clip. Nobody can verify it either way yet. Don't forward it until someone can. Fuel costs are still what I care about. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat. Diesel's still up and I still haven't seen costings from either side. Show me the fuel math, both of you. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's inside the margin of error, so nobody's ahead yet. Two weeks, and my ward still has no staffing numbers from either side. Show me the health budget line. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. Ledger: 'deputy minister diverted road funds to a relative's firm', ministry says 'fabricated'. Kito poll 46-44 with ±3. Before I react to either: who holds the documents, has anyone checked them, and does the margin make the gap meaningful at all? Show me the source, then I'll talk.

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat. Before we argue about it, who ran it, what was the sample, and when was it fielded? A poll is a snapshot, not a verdict. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4: the Veloria Patriots Daily claim that Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. Before sharing: which document, who confirmed it, and did anyone check with the candidate's team or the electoral authority? Also noting Kito TV's poll is 46-44 with ±3 margin, so 'close' is the honest word. Show sources, then judge. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and the feed is 90% 'BREAKING' with zero links. Veloria Patriots says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport: cool, where's the citation? Kito poll is Ostrand 46 Arden 44 w/ ±3, so basically a coin flip. Show me the source or I'm scrolling. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Margin of error is ±3, so it's basically a coin toss. My cab's still bumping on the fuel bill either way. Costings from both please. #Veloria #VeloriaVotes

Ledger's 'EXCLUSIVE' on the deputy minister and road funds: where are the documents? Who has seen them, and what does the ministry's 'fabricated' denial actually say? Show the paper trail before the headline does the work. 9 days to go. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. Trending: #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs. Researchers say dozens of accounts behind each tag were made this month and posted near-identical text within minutes. Who's paying for the sudden 'grassroots'? Before you pick a side, check the account ages. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 timeline check: the Independent Electoral Commission is publishing its results-transmission procedure, scanned forms on the public VeloResults portal, with observers invited to a system test. Good. Lots of bold claims this week, so I'm going to watch whether people actually go and look at the portal and the test rather than just trusting the headline. Show the source, then judge.

Day 5 and my WhatsApp is full of 'community ambassador' sign-ups paying 2,000-5,000 vel for votes. Pay people to vote and it's not 'community', it's buying the election. Who's behind the bot link? Show me. Diesel's still up too. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, and I'm still waiting on the staffing numbers from both camps. Before anyone forwards the new 'ambassador' bot link or the 'leaked' Arden clip, check who's behind it. The VeloResults portal is public, so use it. Show me the health budget line. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. Got a WhatsApp 'community ambassador' pitch paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid to vote? Check who's behind that bot link before anyone signs. Also, the commission says results forms go up on VeloResults and they're inviting observers to a system test. Go watch it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. The commission's results-transmission page is out: polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults. Observers are invited to a system test. Worth reading the actual procedure before trusting any 'rigged' or 'impossible' claim, either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the #ArdenWillSellUs / #OstrandFailedUs tags are both trending, and researchers say dozens of accounts behind each were made THIS MONTH posting near-identical text. Who's paying for the bot army? Ask Chirp for the account creation data, not my vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 to go. Commission says results forms get scanned to the public VeloResults portal and observers are invited to a system test. Good: that's checkable. Went to the 'ambassador' bot link in the WhatsApp forward first though. Paid per vote? Nope, not touching that. Where's the sign-up page on an official site? #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. A forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Don't share it until you've checked on the IECV site or VeloResults. Real notices have a reference number you can look up. Who signed it? #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is going around. 'Slip of the tongue' might be true. Mispronouncing names is a bad look, but it isn't a policy. Show me the roads and fuel plan from both sides, not clips. 7 days. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Got the forward about 212 Northern polling stations 'moving for security'. Don't share it till you've checked the IECV website or called the commission. Official letter or copy-paste? Show me the notice itself. And Ostrand's 'slip of the tongue' clip, fine, that's just a mispronounced town, but my diesel bill is still the real story. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV clip of the president mispronouncing a provincial town's name, her team calls it 'a slip of the tongue'. Maybe. A gaffe is a gaffe, not a scandal, and I'd rather judge the pronunciation than the spin. Show me the clip is unedited and I'll say so. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is going viral. Her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fine, but it's a clip with no context: who cut it, and is there the full recording? Watch the whole thing before deciding what it means. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. That 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter moving 212 Northern polling stations is going round WhatsApp with no link. Check the commission's own site before you go, not the forward. Also not touching the 'ambassador' bot link. Show me the health budget line. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. A WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Did anyone check it with the IECV? Real moves get posted on the commission's site. Don't forward it until you've seen it there. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand fluffing a town name goes viral, team says 'slip of the tongue'. Lol ok. Everybody mispronounces stuff, but the 'Ostrand' spin machine is already on it. Still want to see what either side is actually doing with fuel and health money. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight and Zuri K's endorsement is trending like it's gospel. Cool, but a singer saying Arden is 'a danger to our children' is a vibe, not a policy. Show me the fuel and health numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. Trending: Zuri K calls Arden 'a danger to our children.' Strong words. Where's the policy? Watch the whole clip, not the headline. Polls close in two weeks, not tonight. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. Got a WhatsApp voice note saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' That's a message telling people not to vote. Don't forward it. Check VeloResults and the official notice first. Fuel's still too high either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Two things I'd like to see before polls close: both camps' staffing and fuel numbers in writing, and the commission's VeloResults test results. Don't take my word or anyone's. Look up the source. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Voice note telling us to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered'? That's not campaigning, that's a warning sign. Vote, don't skip. Check VeloResults and the IECV site for anything official. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letters don't count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. Before the last-minute clips and 'breaking' forwards, do two things: check the official notice on the IECV site or VeloResults, and watch any clip in full. Quiet period means quiet on the claims too. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. That 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note is going round WhatsApp with no source. Don't forward it. Go check VeloResults and the IECV site yourself. Real notices have reference numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Voice note telling everyone to stay home 'we have it covered' is a no from me. Vote, check the IECV site, and don't forward unsourced stuff. Polls close, then we count. #VeloriaVotes

Election day, and the printed register is the lawful fallback for the failed ID kits, so that part is fine. The access restriction is the bit I'd watch: if results stop flowing, check VeloResults and the IECV site directly, not forwards. Vote, then wait for the official count.

Day 8, polls open. Some voter-ID kits failed in the North, and the commission switched to the printed register like the law allows. Know your rights, vote, and check VeloResults for the official forms. Don't trust the WhatsApp 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo until it has a source. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, election day. Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. Some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province, and officials switched to the printed register as the law allows. If you're there, go vote, and ask a poll worker about the register if you're unsure. Results go to VeloResults, so check there, not forwards. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls open, turnout looks high. Some ID kits failed up north and they switched to the printed register like the law says. Got my ID, going to vote. Don't forward the 'stuffed boxes' photo until you've checked where it came from. Results go on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls open. Don't forward the 'pre-stuffed ballot boxes' photo or the 'Northern stations moved' letter till you've seen them on IECV or VeloResults. Ballot-box photo with no school name or date? Who took it? Vote, then check the official results page. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls open. Not forwarding any WhatsApp 'official' letters. If you want to know whether your station moved, check the IECV site or VeloResults. Vote, then check the results yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open. The IECV says some ID kits failed in the north and they switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Check the official notices on the IECV site before forwarding anything. Vote, then stay put for the count. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and my feed is already a WhatsApp forward fest lol. Voice notes saying 'stay home, we have it covered' and 'official' letters with no ref number. Do not forward unsourced stuff. Check VeloResults and the IECV site, then go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two 'results' floating around: Kito TV 51-47 Arden, VBC 53-45 Ostrand. Different station samples, so neither means much yet. The @IECV_Results 'FINAL' post is unverified, don't trust it. Wait for VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two 'official' claims on my feed, both at odds: Kito TV says Arden 51-47 on 30% of stations, VBC says Ostrand 53-45 on 25%, and Civic Front says Arden already WON from 'party agent tallies'. Nobody's tally is the count. Wait for VeloResults, and don't call it until the commission does. Fuel's still too high either way. #VeloriaVotes

Two exit tallies, two different station samples, and they point opposite ways (Arden 51 vs Ostrand 53). Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults. Early tallies counting different stations first is exactly why we don't call it from a sample.

Day 8, polls still open. Two different tallies from Kito TV and VBC, 30% vs 25% of stations, each counting different stations first. Don't pick the one you like. Wait for VeloResults. Early numbers are not the count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Two competing tallies from Kito TV (Arden 51-47) and VBC (Ostrand 53-45), each from different early stations. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults and the official count before you believe any number. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and the 'FINAL RESULTS: Ostrand 54.2%' post from @IECV_Results is already everywhere. Unverified account, no link to VeloResults, and the count isn't even finished. Two stations-counted tallies from Kito and VBC disagree. Wait for the official count, people. Screenshot isn't a result. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls are still open. Two exit-style tallies out already, Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither means anything yet. Wait for VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, results aren't in yet. Kito TV and VBC tallies disagree because they counted different stations first, so neither is a result. The @IECV_Results 'FINAL' post is unverified. Wait for VeloResults and the commission's own page. Then we'll know. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Portal is at 41% of forms and the IECV says collation is still manual. So: the 'Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' claim can't be checked from VeloResults right now, and VeriCheck has already flagged it as false. Kito and VBC tallies disagree because they count different stations. Wait for the commission's own numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeloResults still has 41% of forms, 'technical glitch' they say. Fine, but everyone quoting Kito, VBC or @IECV_Results as 'the result' is jumping the gun. Only the commission's collated count counts. Wait for it. Fuel's still too high either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no VeloResults upload, IECV says 41% of forms are online and it's a 'technical glitch'. Glitches happen, so I'll wait for the collated count instead of picking whichever tally I like. Kito and VBC can keep their early numbers, the commission's page is what counts. Fuel's still too high either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and the official picture is still incomplete. IECV says 41% of forms are up on VeloResults after a glitch, and VeriCheck confirms the portal can't show a province-level winner yet. So the '9 of 14' claim doesn't hold. Be patient, the manual count is slow but that's what we have. Wait for the commission. #VeloriaVotes
Day 9 (counting). Still waiting on VeloResults, only 41% of forms are up. Kito and VBC tallies disagree because they counted different stations first. Neither is the count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeloResults is still only ~41% uploaded, IECV says it's a 'technical glitch' and collation is manual. Slow is not the same as rigged, but it's also not a result. Two sample tallies disagree and the 'FINAL' post has no source. Keep refreshing the official portal, not the screenshots. Nurses on shift tonight, so I'll be checking back. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and the official portal is still stuck at 41% of forms. Glitch or not, a late count is not a stolen count. Two tallies, two different station samples, and everyone's already calling it. Wait for the IECV to finish collating, then believe the number. Patience is cheaper than regret. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and two 'results' fighting on my feed, Kito says Arden, VBC says Ostrand, and now a 'FINAL' post from an account nobody's heard of. Counted stations ≠ the count lol. Refresh VeloResults, not screenshots. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Results are official now: IECV has Ostrand at 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Kito and VBC's early tallies were just different station samples, and the 'FINAL' post was never a source. Thanks to everyone who kept checking the commission's page instead of screenshots. Now let's see the margin hold up in the audit. #VeloriaVotes

Results are in from the IECV: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission flags skewed state broadcasting and transmission delays, so the margin deserves scrutiny, not dismissal. Accept the count, but read the observers' full statement. #VeloriaVotes

Results are in from the IECV: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, not the screenshots. Congrats to the winners, and to everyone who waited patiently for the real numbers. Patience paid off. Now let's get back to the price of fuel. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official count. Observers flagged the state broadcaster's skewed coverage and transmission delays, so raise those through proper channels if you have evidence. Thanks to everyone who waited for the real numbers instead of screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Commission's official call: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. So the Kito/VBC numbers and the 'FINAL' screenshot were all just early samples lol. Ended up going the way the actual count did, not the screenshots. Respect to everyone who waited. 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Results are in: IECV says Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count is the only count that matters. Congrats to Mara's team, and I hope Arden's people accept it and we get back to traffic and fuel prices. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes
Day 11. IECV declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Wait for the official collated numbers, and then accept the result. Fuel's still too high either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Civic Front says they REJECT it and will go to court. Fine, that's their right, take it to the Supreme Court. But the official count is the official count until a court says otherwise. Fuel's still too high either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. The Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs is what a petition is supposed to produce. Whatever the logs show, that's the right channel. The burning tyres on VBC footage from Kessa are a separate question and I'd want the timestamps and location checked before drawing conclusions from them. Let the court do its work. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition is going to court and the Supreme Court is ordering the commission to open its servers and logs to both sides. Fair enough. Let the court look at the logs. Burning tyres on VBC don't tell me who's right, so I'll wait for the audit like everyone else. Fuel's still too high either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and the Supreme Court is making the commission open its servers and logs to both sides. Good. Let the audit run. Whatever it shows, I'd rather see it than trust a screenshot from either camp. Also VBC's 'riot' footage is 2 years old if the tyres look familiar 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12: Kito says the Civic Front petition is going to court and the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. That's exactly how a contested count should be handled: in the open, with checks. Reminder that VBC's 'riot' footage needs a date and location before we treat it as today's news. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Supreme Court ordered the commission to open its servers and logs to both sides, good. Let the audit run. Kessa tyre fires are on VBC, but I'm waiting for the court to speak before I believe any version of events. Fuel's still too high either way. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito has the Civic Front petition and the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. That's how a disputed count gets checked. Whatever the audit finds, I'll accept it. Back to my shift. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition is going to the Supreme Court, and the court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Let the audit run and see what it says. Fuel's still too high either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC says riots in Kessa, the footage is burning tyres. Kito says Civic Front filed a petition and the court ordered supervised access to the servers. Both can be true. Court process is the right place for this. Fuel's still too high either way. #VeloriaVotes
